checks.title: Confirm scope and owners
checks.instructions: Record written target, environment, allowed actors, rate and data bounds, stop conditions, security/asset/closure owners, and a first read-only outcome.

checks.title: Freeze permission policy
checks.instructions: Record policy revision and expected role, tenant, ownership, resource and action cells before testing. A current UI state is not an approved policy.

checks.title: Prepare isolated test identity
checks.instructions: Bind exact deployed build, fixture and authorized actor/tenant/resource IDs. Exclude real customer data unless separately authorized.

checks.title: Prove one selected cell
checks.instructions: Capture UI and direct server result, attempt ID, observation time and redacted trace for the same actor/resource/action. A hidden button alone cannot prove denial.

checks.title: Reuse or propose Security Crews
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Access Review Analyst and Security Remediation Coordinator capabilities and access; preserve compatible Crew identities.

checks.title: Probe policy and delivery sources
checks.instructions: Read current policy, issue, approval, repository, deployment and independent retest sources or scoped exports; record exact IDs and missing access.

checks.title: Install blocking checks
checks.instructions: Bind artifact paths and validator steps before Remediation and reporting. Reject mismatched policy/cell/build, UI-only denial, unapproved change, wrong deployed build and self-reviewed or wrong-cell closure.

checks.title: Review proposed Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, selected policy cell, source paths, validator commands, approval/notification boundaries, stable case key, manual route and cost.

checks.title: Run an authorized case manually
checks.instructions: Retain real source reads, matrix, pending ledger, validation, owner review and a negative control. Fictional examples do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. A policy or deployment event needs authentication, exact scope, deduplication, policy/build reset, cost, owner review and explicit activation.
